newsitem.title: UK: UK Conservative Cash warns against "German Europe".
newsitem.headline: UK Conservative Cash warns against "German Europe".

text.p: Britain is being dragged towards a Europe dominated by Germany in which it will be forced to fight in foreign wars against its will, Bill Cash, a prominent Conservative "Euro-sceptic", said on Tuesday.

In a speech on the fringe of the party's annual conference, Cash said Germany's ambassador to Britain was on the record as saying it was Germany's historic mission to provide the will needed to overcome arguments against a single European currency.

"In a word, to use their will to destroy our Westminster democracy and the right of the British people, all of you, to govern yourselves. That is the dreadful truth -- that is the issue. That is what we must reverse.
"They exert their will -- we do not. We are heading for one country -- a German Europe," Cash warned.

He said Germany was insisting that Britain, having surrendered its veto over monetary union at Maastricht, now give up its veto on foreign policy and defence. "This would lead progressively to your children and grandchildren being forced to fight in foreign wars against British will," Cash said.
"These are powerful reminders of the failure of the policy of appeasement and defeatism in the 1930s, dressed up as negotiations," he added.
